scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Hoo! Hah! Hoo! Hah!
Let me take you away to
a distant spiritual place,
a land of exotic mystery,
my hometown Ayothaya!
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
呼！哈！呼！哈！
让我带你前往一个遥远的灵性之地，
一片充满异域神秘色彩的土地，
那就是我的家乡——哎哟泰雅！

scripts.text: About Ayothaya.
scripts.translation: 关于哎哟泰雅。

scripts.text: Go to Ayothaya.
scripts.translation: 前往哎哟泰雅。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
We Ayothayans are a pious people who value peace and sincerity. We endeavor to lead simple, yet noble, lives in harmony with nature.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
我们哎哟泰雅人虔诚、珍视和平与真诚。我们努力过着简单而高尚的生活，与自然和谐共处。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Our traditional cuisine is world famous. It's no surprise when we serve dishes like Tom Yum Goong, made of Shrimp, Lemon and Chillies, which has a tantalizing aroma and flavor beyond imagining.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
我们的传统美食举世闻名。当我们端出由虾、柠檬和辣椒制成的泰式BBQ时，那令人垂涎的香气和难以想象的美味也就不足为奇了。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
For those who crave adventure, there is an age old story about the Sa-mhing Tiger, an evil creature that haunts our temple ruins.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
对于那些渴望冒险的人来说，这里流传着一个古老的故事：关于萨明虎，一种盘踞在我们寺庙废墟中的邪恶魔物。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Hoo! Hahh! Hoo! Hahh!
No man alive can resist the
call of this beautiful land.
Midgardians are
always welcome!
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
呼！哈！呼！哈！
没有人能抗拒这片美丽土地的召唤。
米德加尔特人
随时欢迎！

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Ah, you must pay 10,000 Zeny
if you wish to visit Ayothaya.
If you're ready, we can leave
right now~
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
啊，如果你想去哎哟泰雅，
需要支付10,000泽尼。
如果你准备好了，
我们现在就可以出发~

scripts.text: I'm ready, let's go!
scripts.translation: 我准备好了，走吧！

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不了。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Hoo! Hah! Hoo! Hah!
Let us be off! Back to my
beautiful Ayothaya!
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
呼！哈！呼！哈！
让我们出发吧！回到我美丽的哎哟泰雅！

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
I am sorry, but you do not have the 10,000 Zeny to travel to Ayothaya. Such a price is nothing compared to the experiences that await you!
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
很抱歉，你没有足够的10,000泽尼前往哎哟泰雅。与等待你的经历相比，这点费用根本不算什么！

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Have you ever dreamed
of a beautiful place filled
with spiritual serenity? You
must have been dreaming
of Ayothaya, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
你是否曾梦想过一个充满灵性宁静的美丽地方？朋友，你一定是在梦想着哎哟泰雅。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Hoo! Hah! Hmm! Hah!
So, how did you like Ayothaya? Did you get a chance to try Tom Yum Goong? When you're ready, I shall take you back home.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
呼！哈！嗯！哈！
那么，你觉得哎哟泰雅怎么样？有机会尝尝泰式BBQ吗？当你准备好时，我会送你回家。

scripts.text: Go back to Alberta.
scripts.translation: 返回艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
You will be welcome to come back whenever you please. I hope that we will see each other again sometime soon. Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
欢迎你随时回来。希望我们很快能再次相见。谢谢~

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Ah yes. I understand that it is difficult to take leave of such a beautiful place. Do not worry
and take your time.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
啊是的。我理解离开这样一个美丽的地方很难。别担心，慢慢来。

scripts.text:
[Thang]
There's an ancient,
dreadful building in
Ayothaya that no one
here dares approach...
scripts.translation:
[唐]
在哎哟泰雅有一座古老而可怕的建筑，
这里没人敢靠近……

scripts.text:
[Thang]
In the past, a few curious people went inside, despite the horror stories, and never returned. What on earth could be going on inside of that place?
scripts.translation:
[唐]
过去，尽管有那些恐怖的故事，仍有几个好奇的人走了进去，却再也没有回来。那个地方里面到底发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Thang]
However, if you want to prove your courage to others, confronting the danger inside might be a worthy challenge for an adventurer...
I think.
scripts.translation:
[唐]
不过，如果你想向他人证明你的勇气，面对里面的危险或许对冒险者来说是个值得的挑战……
我想。

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Hello!
I don't think
we've met before.
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
你好！
我想我们之前没见过。

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
You must be
from Midgard.
After all, I know every single person living in this village.
Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
你一定是来自米德加尔特的吧。
毕竟，这个村庄里的每一个人我都认识。
呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Hmm...
May I ask about the land you
come from? I'm curious about
a lot of things in the outside world.
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
嗯……
我可以问问你来自的地方吗？我对外面世界的很多事情都很好奇。

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
You know, like the dresses and jewelry that ladies wear in other countries, whether or not the men are good looking, what kind of songs you have, what kind of girls that guys over there like...
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
你知道的，比如其他国家女士们穿的裙子和戴的首饰，男人们是否英俊，你们有什么样的歌曲，那边的男子喜欢什么样的女孩……

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Okay~!
Take care and
enjoy your travels!
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
好吧~！
保重，
祝你旅途愉快！

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
When you go East from this
village, you will arrive at the ruins of an old shrine. It is now
a nest full of fearsome monsters.
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
从这个村庄向东走，你会到达一座古老神龛的废墟。现在那里巢穴里充满了可怕的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
If you plan to venture through these ruins, you better prepare
as much as you can!
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
如果你打算探索这些废墟，最好做好充分的准备！

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Ah...
I wonder where
my Black Knight is~
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
啊……
我在想我的黑暗骑士在哪里呢~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't you mean...
Knight in shining armor
riding a white horse?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你不是指……
骑着白马、身穿闪亮盔甲的骑士吗？

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Hmm...?
Oh, well...
I'll take them both!
Hee hee~!
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
嗯……？
哦，好吧……
两个我都要！
嘻嘻~！

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Mmm...?
What's up?
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
嗯……？
怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Ummm.
Hmmmmm...
Ummmmm...?
scripts.translation:
[村民]
嗯。
嗯嗯嗯……
嗯嗯嗯……？

scripts.text:
[Villager]
You must be
an outsider.
Yes. Yes, indeed.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
你一定是个外人。
是的。没错。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Did you just ask
where am I going?
Why, to the Fishing Spot
just ahead. That's what
we old men do: fish.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
你刚才问我要去哪里？
当然是去前面的钓鱼点。这就是我们这些老头子做的事：钓鱼。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Hmmm...
Would you like to hear
something interesting? I've heard that someone found a ring inside
a fish he caught in the
Fishing Spot.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
嗯……
想听点有趣的事吗？我听说有人在钓鱼点钓到的鱼肚子里发现了一枚戒指。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Supposedly, there are lots of stories about people finding valuables inside of the fish they've been catching there.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
据说，有很多关于人们在那里钓到的鱼肚子里发现贵重物品的故事。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
If you're lucky enough,
you might even become
a millionaire.
Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[村民]
如果你足够幸运，
甚至可能成为百万富翁。
嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Villager]
...!?
Ah, I came into the fish market! ^666666*Sigh*^000000 It seems I went the wrong way. The Fishing Spot is on the opposite side of this village.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
…！？
啊，我来到鱼市场了！ ^666666*叹气*^000000 看来我走错路了。钓鱼点在这个村庄的另一边。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Since I'm here, it wouldn't be
a bad idea to look around. All of the seafood in this market is fresh and tasty. You'll regret it if you don't try some of this seafood
at least once.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
既然来了，四处看看也不错。这个市场里的所有海鲜都新鲜美味。如果你不至少尝一次这里的海鲜，一定会后悔的。

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
Phew, isn't it
soooo hot today?
scripts.translation:
[关]
呼，今天是不是太热了？

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
You must be
from Midgard, huh?
I've seen a lot of tourists
coming from there recently.
scripts.translation:
[关]
你一定是来自米德加尔特的，对吧？
最近我看到很多从那里来的游客。

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
You'd better be really careful if you travel outside of the village. Whatever you do, don't go into
the ruins of an old shrine
in the forest.
scripts.translation:
[关]
如果你在村外旅行，最好格外小心。无论如何，不要进入森林里那座古老神龛的废墟。

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
That place is far too
dangerous to visit. Still, I hear that if you had some kind of amulet, you could go there with
a little less worry...
scripts.translation:
[关]
那个地方太危险了，不适合参观。不过，我听说如果你有某种护身符，去那里时可以少一些忧心……

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
Well, anyway, it's still a really good idea to stay away from that place. I hope you enjoy visiting Ayothaya, and that you keep safe~
scripts.translation:
[关]
总之，远离那个地方仍然是个好主意。希望你在哎哟泰雅玩得开心，并保持安全~

scripts.text:
[Detzi]
In Ayothaya, we have our own traditional martial arts. We, the young men of the village, practice our traditional martial arts in order to become strong.
scripts.translation:
[德齐]
在哎哟泰雅，我们有自己的传统武术。我们村里的年轻人练习传统武术以变得强大。

scripts.text:
[Detzi]
Why don't you learn our martial arts? I guarantee that it will help you greatly in your travels.
scripts.translation:
[德齐]
你为什么不学习我们的武术呢？我保证这会对你的旅行有很大帮助。

scripts.text:
[Eik]
Hey...
You look pretty strong
You wanna challenge
me to a match?
scripts.translation:
[艾克]
嘿……
你看起来挺强的。
你想和我比试一下吗？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text: Nah~
scripts.translation: 算了~

scripts.text:
[Eik]
Ow ow ow!
I was just
kidding, man!
scripts.translation:
[艾克]
哎哟哎哟！
我只是开个玩笑，伙计！

scripts.text:
[Eik]
I'm not so rude as to pick fights with strangers for no reason!
scripts.translation:
[艾克]
我可没那么无礼，会无缘无故找陌生人打架！

scripts.text:
[Eik]
Real power is developed after having thousands of matches with other people. So, don't be afraid of fighting, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾克]
真正的力量是在与他人进行成千上万次比试后发展出来的。所以，不要害怕战斗，好吗？
